overview_description.description: Fly is a decentralized liquidity aggregation protocol for cross-chain swaps of crypto assets. The platform aggregates liquidity across multiple blockchains and DEXs to execute fast, cost-effective trades without users interacting with bridges directly. Users connect non-custodial wallets, view portfolio balances across supported chains, and swap a wide variety of tokens, including LP and yield tokens. Fly offers features such as advanced routing, insurance for cross-chain swaps, and a loyalty program with NFT-based rewards. The native FLY token is used for governance, staking, and distributing platform fees to stakers, liquidity providers, and the community.

product.name: Fly dApp
product.description: A non-custodial DeFi application for fast, cost-effective cross-chain crypto swaps and portfolio management across multiple blockchains.

product.name: Magpie Protocol Cross-Chain Swap Platform
product.description: A decentralized liquidity aggregation platform enabling fast, cost-efficient swaps of digital assets across multiple blockchain networks without manual bridging.

product.name: Fly Boost
product.description: A rewards program that grants Eggs, partner rewards, and yield incentives to users who swap or deposit through Fly and partner protocols.

product.name: Magpie Mafia Loyalty Program
product.description: A community engagement program where users earn experience points and rewards by swapping assets, represented by evolving non-transferable NFT avatars.

product.name: Magpie Portfolio Feature
product.description: A portfolio management tool within the dApp that displays users' token balances across supported chains and enables quick trading actions.

product.name: FLY token
product.description: A governance and staking token used to align and incentivize traders, stakers, and liquidity providers, with platform fees redistributed to participants.
